title: Hearty Smoky Irish Potato Grill
description: A winey and glassy-jelly Irish dish featuring gherkin relish and tempering-chocolate, perfect for a post-workout meal
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, toss the sliced potatoes with olive oil, salt, and pepper until they are evenly coated
Grill the potatoes for 10 minutes on each side, or until they are tender and lightly charred
In a small saucepan, heat the red wine over low heat until it is reduced by half
Stir in the gherkin relish and tempering chocolate until the chocolate is melted and the mixture is smooth
Brush the potato slices with the wine and gherkin relish mixture during the last 2 minutes of grilling
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot
